visualReview.reviewMethod: Direct visual inspection of every original PNG through the image viewer; no image edits or generated replacements.
positiveFindings: Initial desktop and mobile panoramas show three distinct complete native people, including all faces, without a stats overlay covering them.
A window open/close contact images show the actual fingers wrapping the cylindrical handle and the changed physical leaf orientation.
Cancellation before/recovered images show release and a lowered arm while the leaf remains partly open.
Mobile 390 by 844 window and panorama views fit the viewport; the scrolled window controls are visible and usable.
limitations: The window contact camera deliberately crops the face to concentrate on the hand and handle.
The recovered hand is partly hidden by the sill/table in the close view; rest is supported by native pose records as well as the lowered arm.
The window-pair panorama partly occludes faces behind the physical frame.
Static screenshots and sampled poses do not establish perceptual motion smoothness; this CI software renderer is slow.

issues.finding: The newly present near-side window frame crosses the original bottle-contact camera. The bottle is effectively hidden and most of the actual grasp/palm is occluded; only some fingers are visible. The original R01 pick/place contact cannot be independently understood from these captured views.
issues.requiredResolution: Restore a genuinely unobstructed observable bottle/grasp view, then obtain fresh source-bound browser evidence. Do not treat geometry checks alone as visual acceptance.
